blocks.body: Mastewal Eyayou is an Ethiopian singer debuted in Ethiopian Idol has gone to release a variety of original songs about different topics. Now releasing a solo Album, The Artist wanted to Create a Mark that embodies Mastewal’s unique soulful style and creative blend of duality in his songs. This showcase the is a story creative process and the final design.
